name: Can you use IKEA cabinets for an ADU kitchen?

mainEntity.name: Are stock cabinet systems a good fit for an ADU kitchen build?
mainEntity.text: Are stock cabinet systems a good fit for an ADU kitchen build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stock cabinets can be a very practical choice for an ADU kitchen, especially when the project needs to balance budget, speed, and good design. Simple layouts often work fine with modular cabinet systems because the dimensions are predictable and the installation is straightforward. The main limitation is that compact ADU kitchens usually need careful fitment, and stock cabinets may require fillers, trim adjustments, or custom pieces to handle odd widths and utility constraints. That does not make them a bad choice; it just means the design should be built around the cabinet system instead of forcing the cabinets to solve every layout problem. Homeowners should also think about durability, drawer quality, hardware, and whether the finish will hold up in a rental or guest suite. A good contractor can make stock cabinets look high-end with the right proportions, countertop selection, and installation details. For many ADUs, the value is excellent if the kitchen design is disciplined and realistic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stock cabinet systems can work well in an ADU kitchen if the layout is simple and the cabinet dimensions fit the plan. They are often cost-effective and fast to source, but they may need fillers, modifications, or upgraded hardware to look built-in and perform well in a compact space.
